services.name: Wreck Fishing
services.desc: Sea bass season opened this past week and we ran our first trip of the year with return clients Keith, Kevin, and Bob. It was a one stop shop in the morning. The crew went right to work filling up the cooler. They had to weave through a bunch of shorts, but got it done plus added a couple nice ling to the box as well. It’s always a pleasure fishing with you guys and we will see you guys several more times this year for your other trips! The great fishing continued again this morning with repeat client Mike out along with John.
